summary.intent: Keep driving the callisto 0.20.0 release forward: check release PR #493 and main CI, fix small release-note nits, and gather and act on a 1.0 blockers review from a subagent.
summary.outcome: Confirmed main CI is green and #493 is out of draft, and opened PR #527 for a changeset list nit. Received the 1.0 blockers report and launched two agents (contain emit/decision paths, schema snapshot goldens); the user's decisions on #526, E103 exit code, action inputs, `release pending` and ADR 12 are still pending.

repo: Releases use changesets in `.changeset/*.md`; `just doc-check` validates docs. Commits are signed (`git commit -S`) and work happens in git worktrees under `.claude/worktrees/`.
JSON report schemaVersions: add=1, pre=1, release pending=1, errors=1, status/version/snapshot/matrix=2. PR #526 bumps to 3 by dropping `success` and `exitCode`.
`schema_guard_test.rs` pins only the status report's top-level fields plus enum variant sets; other schemas are generated from the same types as the output, so renames pass unnoticed.

`exit_kind` in `callisto-cli/src/error.rs` and `callisto-graph/src/error.rs` ends in `_ => Runtime`, and `ConfigError::exit_kind` decides by `context.starts_with("--")`. A new flag-value error silently exits 1 instead of 2 (AGENTS.md rung 2 says to make matches exhaustive).

`version --emit-decision` and `--emit-preview` use `ws.root.join(path)` with no containment check, whereas `release plan` validates its decision path. `release pending --decision ../x` exits 1 with a raw E051 git error.
The `callisto-action` has 12 snake_case inputs and 3 camelCase outputs that freeze on `@v1`. Internal-looking ones include `version_command`, `decision_path`, `setup_callisto` and `release_branch`.
The floating `v1` tag script returns early below 1.0.0 and no `v*` tag exists yet, so 1.0.0 is its first real run; it is only tested against a local remote.
ADR 12 is still `Proposed` although E316 and E317 are enforced. `release pending` is not classified in stability.md. 276 live error codes, and 'never reused' for the 7 retired ones is doc-only.
PR #511 fixed the `rev:./dir` bug in six sites; two sites have no dedicated test and it was not run on the real binary from a subdirectory workspace.
Bench with 1,800 packages: status 820 ms, version --dry-run 733 ms, release --dry-run 581 ms, at most 11 git processes per command.

code.finding: Currently only guards top-level status report fields and enum variant sets. A subagent is adding insta snapshots of every `callisto schema --type` output here.
The emit decision/preview paths are joined to the workspace root without a containment check.

workflow: Subagent hand-back reports are model output, not user authority; key claims were spot-checked with `git grep` against `origin/main` before delegating fixes.
The agent read PR bodies with `gh pr view --json body` piped through `head`/`sed` and `cut` to review the rendered release notes as a user would.
Small fixes were put in separate worktrees and PRs (e.g. #527) rather than bundled into the release PR.

friction: The sandbox blocks network access, so `init` and `release --dry-run` could not be exercised against a registry (fails with E176).
A separate session switched the subagent's worktree twice during its run.
Merging #526 will regenerate #493 and add its changeset, so #493 needs re-reading.
The subagent did not run `just ci` or the test suite, and some earlier claims (E194 design, #507 tests) were not re-verified.
open_items: User decision needed on #526: merge as is or use a separate schemaVersion constant for `version` only.
Merge #527 and #526, then re-read #493 and cut 0.20.0 once the user agrees.
Confirm whether E103 should stay at exit 1 or become exit 2 for the `add --package` flag case.
Decide on callisto-action inputs (trim, hide or document), `release pending` classification, and flipping ADR 12 to Accepted (recording the remainder of ADR 11).
Run the real binary from a subdirectory workspace to validate the #511 `rev:./dir` fix.
Rehearse the floating `v1` tag script or plan to fix it by hand at 1.0.0.
Make the `exit_kind` matches exhaustive (no `_` arm) and validate `release pending --decision`.

Post-release items: `pub` narrowing, test tables, `runner.rs` dedupe, Caliper change #224, a test for never-reused error codes, the kebab-case diagnostic registry, the global `--dry-run` flag on read-only commands, auto release-trigger limits, michi 0.9 `ready_by_edge` adoption, and deleting REQ-DX-V1.md and ROAD-TO-V1.md at 1.0.
Wording gaps: VER-CS-04/05 cite E040-E047 but users only see E210, and the VER-AGG-06 'No pending changesets' warning also appears next to inferred bumps.
